changes.summary: Records USDA's announced $8 billion Harvest Fuel Relief Program while preserving unresolved payment rates, applications and disbursement.
changes.duplicate_review: The program is distinct from the earlier off-road dyed-diesel tax order and from campaign proposals; no current record covered this CCC/FSA payment program.

source_inspections.evidence_extract: USDA announced $8 billion in one-time Harvest Fuel Relief support under the Commodity Credit Corporation Charter Act, administered by FSA. The formula uses planted-acre, production-cost, yield and price data; crop insurance is not required. Title I rates are expected in November and other eligibility and methodology will follow.
